name: seerr-mcp-server
description: Search Jellyseerr/Overseerr, check availability, and create guarded media requests.

seerr_base_url.title: Seerr base URL
seerr_base_url.description: Required. Base URL of the Jellyseerr/Overseerr instance, e.g. http://localhost:5055. No /api/v1 suffix, no trailing slash.

seerr_api_key.title: Seerr API key
seerr_api_key.description: Required. Jellyseerr API key (Settings → General → API Key), sent as the X-Api-Key header.
